workflow_versions._comment: gh-aw compiler version each agentic workflow is compiled with. Not managed by gh-aw itself — update manually when deliberately bumping one workflow. A workflow missing here falls back to the setup entry's version above. See copilot-setup-steps.yml for why these are split: the three copilot-loop workflows moved to v0.89.21 for the enforced required-labels fix on resolve-pull-request-review-thread; the other six are still on v0.86.2.
